definition.diabetes: Hypothetical membership flag D=1; not a glucose threshold or diagnostic rule.
definition.carrier: Hypothetical person-level flag G=1 for synthetic:monogenic-reference; no real variant interpretation.
definition.expressed_case: D=1 and aetiologic case flag E=1; carrier route additionally conditions expression on G=1.
definition.detected: Expressed case and hypothetical detection flag; model state, not observed diagnosis.
definition.diagnosis_delay: Historical interval from first joint synthetic D=1/E=1 state to first synthetic detection among detected cases. Not necessarily within the reference year; not age at onset or time to a genetic test.
definition.annual_exposure: Closed cohort: each expressed person contributes one full case-year; no entry, exit, death or competing event during the reference year.
definition.complication_eligibility: Every expressed person is assumed free of the hypothetical composite complication at year start and followed for the full year.
definition.unclassified: Excluded from classified-case calculations and reported as unavailable aetiology, not zero.
definition.complication: At most one hypothetical composite complication per expressed person during one year; not incidence of a named clinical endpoint.
definition.cost_perspective: Direct healthcare, one-year horizon, invented 2025 currency; no discounting or broad cost-envelope allocation.

dependence: Primary parameter draws independent by assumption; shared-versus-independent two-stratum structural scenarios required.
